integrity: Exact symbolic case proof of the absence of excitation after time two, a 256-state cyclic transfer formula, exhaustive state-space comparisons on specified finite sizes, and independent transfer-code comparisons. Finite computations are checks, not the universal proof.
limitations: Restricted to the wheel family, threshold two and \(q\ge4\); no claims for other geometries, thresholds or \(q=3\). Archived threshold-range literature precedes the dated 1993 preprint but does not expose an earlier verified day; historical priority is subject to unindexed earlier results.
scientific_scope: Synchronous \(q\)-state threshold-two Greenberg–Hastings automaton on \(W_n=K_1\vee C_n\), \(q\ge4\), \(n\ge3\); the terminal population for \(n\ge4\) is an exact two-motif cyclic-word count.
title: Two motif channels control the sharp extinction shell of multistate excitable wheels
